command:
set -eu
cd /work
export TMPDIR=/work
tar -xf - --no-same-owner -C /work
test -f Candidate.ml && test -f checker.ml
set +e
/home/opam/.opam/5.5/bin/ocamlc -w +a -o probe Candidate.ml checker.ml >compile.stdout 2>compile.stderr
compile_status=$?
set -e
printf 'SFT_COMPILE_STATUS:%s\n' "$compile_status"
cat compile.stdout compile.stderr
if [ "$compile_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$compile_status"; fi
# Limit candidate stdout/stderr files to 64 KiB without raising the hard
# file-size limit inherited by the unprivileged process.
ulimit -f 128
set +e
./probe >candidate.stdout 2>candidate.stderr
candidate_status=$?
set -e
printf 'SFT_CANDIDATE_STATUS:%s\n' "$candidate_status"
cat candidate.stdout candidate.stderr
printf '%s\n' 'SFT_PROBE_COMPLETE_0cc9ef870b2bf74631321e4bcce0cb5f'
test "$candidate_status" -eq 0
stdout:
SFT_COMPILE_STATUS:0
File "Candidate.ml", line 1:
Warning 70 [missing-mli]: Cannot find interface file.

File "checker.ml", line 1:
Warning 70 [missing-mli]: Cannot find interface file.
SFT_CANDIDATE_STATUS:0
SFT_PROBE_COMPLETE_0cc9ef870b2bf74631321e4bcce0cb5f
